sources.title: Build the models your agent needs – distil labs
sources.snippet: It is not just about the performance–it’s about delivering private, accurate AI that’s ready for enterprise scale. ... We needed a small model that could power our product on an IBM P11, entirely on-premises. distil labs’ fine-tuned models allowed us to ship a self-contained solution where the SLM and our graph platform coexist on the same hardware.
